tokens.faq_1_question: What should I do immediately if my roof is damaged during a storm?
tokens.faq_1_answer: Move away from leaking areas, place buckets to catch water, protect valuable furniture, and call our 24/7 emergency dispatch for immediate roof tarping.
tokens.faq_2_question: Why is emergency roof tarping so important after wind or hail damage?
tokens.faq_2_answer: Tarping prevents rainwater from pouring into your attic, ruining insulation, collapsing drywall, and spawning toxic mold before permanent repairs can be completed.
tokens.faq_3_question: Do you help with insurance claims for storm damage?
tokens.faq_3_answer: Yes! We provide comprehensive damage inspections, photo reports, and meet directly with your insurance adjuster to ensure your claim covers all necessary repairs.
tokens.faq_4_question: How fast can your emergency crew arrive to tarp my roof?
tokens.faq_4_answer: During severe weather events and storm alerts, our emergency response teams typically arrive on-site within 30 to 45 minutes.
tokens.faq_5_question: Are your roofing technicians licensed and insured?
tokens.faq_5_answer: Every technician on our crew is fully licensed, background-checked, insured, and certified in high-wind and storm restoration safety.
